2026.headline: 3-3, up two spots, and the win that ended Johnny4Skins' streak
story: CMac91 asked in round 5 whether there were seriously 23 rounds, played through round 11, and let the robot finish the draft, which gave him twelve autopicks. The first-round pick was James Cook, followed by CeeDee Lamb at 2.02 and Bo Nix at 3.02.

Week 4 brought 183.42, the high score of the week. Week 5 brought 74.52, the lowest. Week 6 was a 127.72 to 106.06 win over Johnny4Skins with James Cook leading at 24.3 and 17.56 left on the bench, which ended Johnny4Skins' four-game winning streak.
At 3-3 he rose two spots to 6th. FAAB is a full $500 and the 1.08 is his. The desk's view is the same as before: the roster is fine and the lineup is the variable.
takes: Depth first, spending never, and a streak ended.
It works, until it does not.
